thesis: STX shows textbook VCP breakout (score 64, tightening contractions) at all-time high with strong RS (99.0), grade-A fundamentals (108% EPS growth, expanding margins), and all 8 Minervini criteria met. Strong market regime and high institutional ownership support momentum continuation.

LITE has excellent VCP structure (score 65, tightening to 8.17% last contraction) and RS 100, but volume is drying (warning flag) and recent price action shows fatigue near highs. Last contraction too tight—may lack momentum. Grade B fundamentals and elevated forward PE (58) raise caution. Hold for sharper pullback confirmation.

GEV pulled back 7.53% from recent high ($1149.53), now at $1062.95. VCP is present but not tightening (score 52). While grade-A fundamentals and 178% YoY return are impressive, the pullback violates proximity-to-high criterion for entry now. Better entry likely on consolidation or re-test of MA support.

GOOGL at all-time high with VCP (score 57, tightening), all 8 criteria met, RS 94, and grade-B fundamentals (82% EPS growth, 57% net margin, expanding). Though revenue growth moderate (22%), strong profitability and mega-cap liquidity reduce risk. Tight ATR and small suggested stop make risk/reward favorable.

TER pulled back 17.38% from peak ($418) but shows tight VCP (score 66, 14.54% last contraction, tightening). RS 98, strong fundamentals (81% EPS, 44% revenue growth), and all 8 criteria met. Recent recovery from $306 suggests support holding. Entry here offers better risk/reward than at peak.

GOOG (class C shares) mirrors GOOGL with identical fundamentals, VCP structure (score 62, tightening), RS 94, at all-time high. All 8 criteria passed. Slightly lower institutional ownership (61% vs 81%) but solid technicals and market regime remain positive. Tight stop makes position manageable.

CASY shows excellent VCP structure (score 76, very tight 3.99% last contraction, strong volume ratio 2.18) and all 8 criteria met. However, fundamentals are weak—grade C, only 0.3% revenue growth, 3.3% net margin, and forward PE 42. High valuation + weak fundamentals relative to tape setup warrant caution despite clean chart.

CSCO at all-time high with tight VCP (score 67, 6.23% last contraction) and all 8 criteria, but volume is drying. RS 82 is lowest on list, and fundamentals are modest (31% EPS, 10% revenue growth, forward PE 20). Setup is clean but lacks conviction—hold for pullback or stronger momentum confirmation.
